visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women stand in a professional studio setting. The woman on the left wears a purple fuzzy cardigan over a white shirt and plaid skirt, while the woman on the right wears a white cardigan. They smile and gesture towards the camera in front of blue digital monitors displaying the "aotter" logo. (2) The scene cuts to a cluttered white storage cabinet. A red Mario-themed hat sits on the top shelf alongside a yellow dinosaur plush and various red decorative boxes. The middle shelves are filled with notebooks, pens, and miscellaneous small containers in a disorganized manner. (3) The woman in white holds a transparent plastic bag containing an HP-branded screen and keyboard cleaning kit. She points at the label with her right hand while the woman in purple looks on from the background. The studio lighting is bright and clear. (4) A fast-paced hand-held shot shows the two women struggling over a yellow package. The woman in purple holds a black cleaning brush and a blue toothbrush. Their facial expressions are animated and humorous, suggesting a lighthearted conflict. (5) The woman in white presents a white box containing multiple old smartphones, including a white iPhone and a red device. She looks at the camera with a confused expression, her eyebrows raised, while the woman in purple gestures with her fingers in the background. (6) A close-up shot of the woman in purple wearing yellow sunglasses on her head. She holds a small white object and speaks directly to the camera with a serious but comedic facial expression, emphasizing her point with hand movements. (7) The woman in white holds up a long, bright pink sequined mermaid tail skirt. She smiles widely, showing the shimmering texture of the fabric. The background remains the white cabinet filled with various props and office items. (8) The woman in purple wears the pink sequined mermaid skirt and poses playfully on the floor. The woman in white sits beside her, clutching her head and laughing at the absurdity of the situation. The camera moves slightly to capture the action. (9) The woman in white stares intensely at the camera lens with a wide-eyed, distressed expression as if asking for help. The video concludes with a graphic screen featuring a stylized logo and text inviting viewers to join as members.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Two female voices engage in a rapid, high-energy conversation in Traditional Chinese. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a tempo of approximately 124 BPM, featuring bright synthesizer plucks and a rhythmic kick drum. The vocal tone is friendly and animated. (2) A sharp transition occurs as one woman shouts "不可能那麼亂" with high vocal arousal and a sharp pitch contour. This is followed by a burst of high-pitched laughter and the sound of objects being rustled on a shelf, creating a chaotic acoustic atmosphere. (3) The speech intensity drops to moderate conversational levels as they discuss a cleaning kit. The BGM continues unabated. Distinct metallic and plastic clicking sounds are heard as the kit is handled, indicating the physical presence of objects near the microphone. (4) High-pitched shouting and overlapping speech dominate the mix as the women joke about "garbage." The vocal arousal is extremely high, accompanied by the crinkling sound of a plastic yellow bag being pulled and moved. The music provides a lighthearted contrast. (5) The voices shift to a curious and questioning tone while examining smartphones. The speech rate slows slightly, allowing for clearer articulation. The sound of glass or plastic screens tapping against each other is audible over the continuous electronic background music. (6) A collective burst of shouting and laughter occurs, with the word "譴責" repeated with dramatic emphasis. The vocal pitch is high and strained. Sounds of fabric rustling are heard as a sequined garment is unfolded and moved around. (7) The final phase features a mix of playful banter and a concluding, high-pitched plea "來救我" (Save me). The vocal valence is positive despite the mock distress. A brief electronic stinger marks the end as the primary audio track fades into silence.
